why.title: Ke ka Hobaneng ha O Re Tšhebe?
why.antibiotic_desc: Di-nkha tsa rona di tšelwa ke bophelo bo botle ka tlhaho, di sa kollwang ke meriana kapa di-hormone.
why.quality_desc: Re latele melao ya boleng ya SA mme re netefatsa hore di-nkha tsa rona di fihla ka nako.
why.fresh_desc: Di-nkha tsa rona di rekisa ka nako e tseneileng, di tswileng ka mapolasing a rona a Bloemfontein.
why.community_desc: Re thusa boditlhabyadi ba batho ba Bafile ka ho thusa ba bang.

products.title: Di-products tsa Rona

how.title: Ke Tsamaiso e Tsamaiso?
how.step1_desc: Netefatsa odara ya hao mme o tswele pele.
how.step2_desc: Re tlhama di-nkha tsa hao ka lehare la rona.
how.step3_desc: Di-nkha tsa hao di phethahatsoa mme di lokolohile.
how.step4_desc: Fihlella nako ya ho fihlella kapa re romese koanyeng.

cta.title: O Iketsehile ho Reka Di-nkha tse Hloekileng?
